description: Figure 1 is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of tasks associated with each language family. The category axis is the vertical axis, listing language families from top to bottom as: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque; the bars appear ordered from largest at the top to smallest at the bottom. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored bar: IE-Slavic (light blue) extends to just under 80 (approximately 79), IE-Romance (dark blue) to just under 50 (about 48), IE-Germanic (light green) to the mid-40s (about 45), Uralic (green) to about 20, IE-Baltic (light pink) to about 18, IE-other (red) to about 15, IE-Indic (pale yellow) to about 10, Semitic (orange) to about 8, Turkic (light purple) to about 4, and Basque (purple) to about 3; no bars are stacked, grouped, or specially annotated beyond their colors.
